source: archived per-run metrics; no simulation or retraining
source_limitations: Profile errors reaggregated from archived per-run predictions; this does not rerun MD, training or Euler-Lagrange solutions.

The permittivity-transferable functional is reported at seed 0, fixed before training; its single-permittivity entries evaluate the same parameters on the runs of one dielectric constant (data/models/eps75|eps2/FINAL_bwX_01).
Baseline architectures (one-body network, lattice and convolutional free energies) are unchanged from the previous release.
Raw selected pair transfer metrics may include additional linear-response runs p70-p81; the canonical paper subset is p00-p21.
